features.name: Window shell
features.check: Title bar, header, activity bars, sidebars, gaps and status bar at the same sizes and colors

features.name: Welcome screen
features.check: The Projects page with the search field, Open, Clone and the recent projects
gaps: the whole screen (the native welcome view is the empty editor area of an open folder)
Projects, Customize and Learn pages

features.name: Workspaces and folders
features.check: Both repositories of demo/acme in Changes, the header's folder menu
gaps: the folder menu's recent folders, New Window, Open Folder in New Window, workspace files and Close Folder
the clean repositories' list, Set as Active Repository from a menu, remembering the active repository
the Files panel's + button and a folder's right-click menu

features.name: Files panel
features.check: The tree with chevrons, icons, names and status colors; folders open and close
gaps: deleted files in the tree and the exact status letter (U for untracked)
the heading buttons, resizing and hiding the panel

features.name: File operations
features.check: Selection, the right-click menu and New File, Rename, Copy, Move and Trash
gaps: selection and every file operation

features.name: File icons
features.check: Minimal and Material Icons in the Files panel and the tabs
gaps: the Minimal and Material Icons levels (the default, no icons, matches)

features.name: Editor and tabs
features.check: A file in a tab with the path bar, the code and the blame note; the empty editor area without one
gaps: the tab's badge and previous and next change; Blame in the file bar
binary files, images and Markdown previews show only a message
the six actions of the empty editor area do nothing

features.name: Pin, reorder and wrap tabs
features.check: A pinned tab first, dragging tabs, wrapped rows
gaps: file tabs open (preview and kept), switch and close; pinning, dragging, wrapping and the tab menu are missing

features.name: Single tab title
features.check: The file name centered in the strip in Single tab mode

features.name: Split editor
features.check: Three editor groups, each with its tabs

features.name: New File and unsaved changes
features.check: The Untitled tab named after its first line; unsaved text back after a restart

features.name: Unload hidden tabs
features.check: Settings > Editor > Unload hidden tabs; an unloaded tab opens where it was

features.name: Editing code
features.check: Multiple cursors, the Code menu, Go to Line, folding and completion
gaps: completion, Go to Line and the find bar
column selection and dragging text
Settings > Editor (font, cursor, word wrap) keep their defaults

features.name: Code appearance
features.check: Code font, syntax colors, bracket colors and indent guides in the diff panes
gaps: the settings: font, weight, line spacing, whitespace, cursor, word wrap, indentation and zoom

features.name: Markdown editor
features.check: The toolbar, the live preview, mermaid diagrams and the rich editor

features.name: Image and PDF preview
features.check: The image fitted to the tab with its bar; a PDF; an image diff

features.name: Search Everywhere
features.check: The popup with its All, Classes, Files, Symbols and Text tabs
gaps: only the Text tab (Find in Files) searches; All, Classes, Files and Symbols need the symbol index
Replace in Files, the Match Case, Words and Regex toggles, double Shift
a result opens its diff or says the file view is missing (GM-52)

features.name: Quick Open
features.check: Cmd+P with recently opened files, fuzzy file results and the ? help
gaps: the :line, @symbol and #symbol modes
recent files come from the control server until the native file view (GM-52) opens files

features.name: Command Palette
features.check: Shift+Cmd+P: every command with its keys, check marks, enabled ones first; typing filters
gaps: most commands only say they are not in the native app yet
the state is the docs demo's (Generated/PaletteCommands*.swift), not the window's own

features.name: Recent Files
features.check: The popup with the files worked on last, newest first

features.name: Navigation Bar
features.check: The path of the open file; Cmd+Up opens the folder's list with search
gaps: the crumbs of an open file show, but do nothing when clicked
folder lists, search and keys

features.name: Find and replace
features.check: The find bar with Replace, the counter and Replace in Files
